name: SPXI instruments: the methods of spxi.dev/methods carried on other surfaces
rule: A surface listed here labels itself, visibly and in its machine-readable head, with the method it carries, its level and a link to its row in the inventory. 'Instrument of' is kept apart from 'treated by': the SPXI-TLP layer a surface also carries says how it was built, the instrument label says what it is.

instruments.name: Provenance Erasure Rate (PER, with PER-M / PER-C / PER-D)
instruments.what: Frequency with which attribution is dropped from compositions that use the entity's content; target < 0.2. Three atomic dimensions (mention, citation, definition) scored separately.

surfaces.note: The Provenance Erasure Rate is also the Semantic Economy's measure of provenance loss.

instruments.name: Semantic Addresses Framework
instruments.what: A query string plus its operators is an address; observations at an address are classed and canonicalized; one record per address. The unit the Capture Registry is keyed on.

instruments.name: Capture Registry (longitudinal observation)
instruments.what: Dated compositions at named addresses with surface, sign-in condition, verbatim transcript, re-run URL. Nulls recorded as nulls. 484 addresses, 651 observations at v12.1.

instruments.name: Platform Erosion Observatory
instruments.what: Measurement of what happens to records after removal from a host: survival in aggregators, tombstone behaviour, the shape of absence; a 14,284-DOI control cohort.
